preconditions.description: The number of notes is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 2*10**5 for a_i in notes)
preconditions.description: Each note position is between 1 and 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a sequence of n finger assignments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 5 for b_i in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each finger assignment is between 1 and 5.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i != b_j for i in range(n-1) for j in range(i+1, n) if notes[i] == notes[j])
postconditions.description: No two consecutive notes with the same position are assigned the same finger.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i < b_j for i in range(n-1) if notes[i] < notes[i+1])
postconditions.description: If a note is to the left of the next note, the finger assignment increases.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i > b_j for i in range(n-1) if notes[i] > notes[i+1])
postconditions.description: If a note is to the right of the next note, the finger assignment decreases.
